name: CAT/DE Pairs Mean Reversion Strategy
description: Pairs mean reversion strategy on CAT and DE using the CAT/DE price ratio z-score. Computes a 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio. Entry: z-score crosses ±2σ (short CAT/long DE when z>+2, long CAT/short DE when z<-2). Exit: z-score reverts to 0 or capitulation stop at ±3σ. Dollar-neutral with each leg sized at 50% of portfolio equity.
source:
# CAT/DE Pairs Mean Reversion Strategy
# ======================================
# Ratio: CAT price / DE price
# Signal: 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
# Entry: z crosses ±2σ → trade ratio mean reversion
# Exit: z reverts to 0 (mean) or capitulation at ±3σ
# Sizing: Dollar-neutral, 50% per leg (one long, one short)

# ============================================================================
# DATA: Load both assets via reference_stocks (same data regardless of asset)
# ============================================================================
cat_data = reference_stocks(ticker="CAT")()
de_data = reference_stocks(ticker="DE")()
cat_close = cat_data.c
de_close = de_data.c

# ============================================================================
# RATIO AND Z-SCORE
# ============================================================================

# CAT/DE price ratio
ratio = cat_close / de_close

# 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
z_ratio = zscore(window=252)(ratio)

# ============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS (pulses from crossovers)
# ============================================================================

# z crosses above +2: ratio is high → short CAT, long DE
enter_ratio_high = crossover(z_ratio, 2)

# z crosses below -2: ratio is low → long CAT, short DE
enter_ratio_low = crossunder(z_ratio, -2)

# ============================================================================
# EXIT SIGNALS
# ============================================================================

# Mean reversion exit: z-score crosses back to 0
exit_to_mean_down = crossunder(z_ratio, 0)   # coming down through 0 (exit ratio_high trade)
exit_to_mean_up = crossover(z_ratio, 0)      # coming up through 0 (exit ratio_low trade)

# Capitulation stops: z-score extends to ±3σ in adverse direction
stop_ratio_high = crossover(z_ratio, 3)      # z hits +3 while in short-CAT/long-DE trade
stop_ratio_low = crossunder(z_ratio, -3)     # z hits -3 while in long-CAT/short-DE trade

# ============================================================================
# TRADE STATE MANAGEMENT (hold_until for persistent states)
# ============================================================================

# Ratio-high state: active from z>+2 until mean reversion, capitulation, or opposite entry
exit_high = exit_to_mean_down or stop_ratio_high or enter_ratio_low
in_ratio_high = hold_until()(enter=enter_ratio_high, exit=exit_high)

# Ratio-low state: active from z<-2 until mean reversion, capitulation, or opposite entry
exit_low = exit_to_mean_up or stop_ratio_low or enter_ratio_high
in_ratio_low = hold_until()(enter=enter_ratio_low, exit=exit_low)

# Detect state exit transitions (going flat)
was_high = in_ratio_high >> 1
was_low = in_ratio_low >> 1
exit_high_to_flat = was_high and not in_ratio_high and not in_ratio_low
exit_low_to_flat = was_low and not in_ratio_low and not in_ratio_high

# ============================================================================
# DIRECTION PER ASSET
# ============================================================================
is_cat = is_asset_ref(ticker="CAT")()
is_de = is_asset_ref(ticker="DE")()

# CAT: long when ratio_low, short when ratio_high
# DE:  long when ratio_high, short when ratio_low (inverted)

# Active trade long entries (persistent while in state)
active_long = (in_ratio_low and is_cat) or (in_ratio_high and is_de)

# Active trade short entries (persistent while in state)
active_short = (in_ratio_high and is_cat) or (in_ratio_low and is_de)

# Exit-to-flat: fire opposing entry pulse to close position
# When ratio_high exits to flat: close short CAT (fire long), close long DE (fire short)
# When ratio_low exits to flat: close long CAT (fire short), close short DE (fire long)
flat_long_pulse = (exit_high_to_flat and is_cat) or (exit_low_to_flat and is_de)
flat_short_pulse = (exit_low_to_flat and is_cat) or (exit_high_to_flat and is_de)

# Combined signals: active trade states + flat-exit close pulses
long_entry = active_long or flat_long_pulse
short_entry = active_short or flat_short_pulse

# ============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# ============================================================================

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Dollar-neutral sizing: 50% per leg during active trades
# Rebalance on any state transition to update position size
in_trade = in_ratio_high or in_ratio_low
was_in_trade = was_high or was_low
state_changed = (in_trade and not was_in_trade) or (not in_trade and was_in_trade) or (in_ratio_high and was_low) or (in_ratio_low and was_high)

# Active trades: 50% per leg. Exit pulses: minimal 1% (closes on next real entry)
target_size = 50 if in_trade else 1

position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=target_size, rebalance_on=state_changed)
